name: Hassan Md. Sharfuddin Miraz
bio: DevOps Engineer at SDB IT, Uttara, Dhaka. Expert in AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines & container orchestration. Published IEEE researcher in ML & AI. Has architected and deployed production systems powering 50,000+ concurrent users. Passionate about helping career changers break into DevOps with real mentorship — not just videos.
